subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so which default-off renderer, config, dependency, and sanitizer approach should be accepted?
rationale: The request has clear user value and fits web frontend ergonomics, but the implementation choice creates a core UI dependency/config contract and changes sanitization for untrusted chat content.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one current KaTeX, MathJax, or MathML implementation to completion with dependency/security approval and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

options.title: Defer out of core
options.body: Keep the built-in markdown renderer unchanged until a plugin or extension API can own math rendering without expanding core UI dependencies and sanitizer policy.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decline first-party Control UI math rendering for now and close the related candidate PRs and duplicate requests with a clear product rationale.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one current KaTeX, MathJax, or MathML implementation to completion with dependency/security approval and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is mainly a product/config/security-boundary decision, and steipete has adjacent Control UI chat, dependency, and config history.
